scripts.dev: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --parallel --stream --filter @x/shared --filter @x/server --filter @x/client run dev
scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm --filter @x/shared build && pnpm --filter @x/server build && pnpm --filter @x/client build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter @x/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @x/client typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
